body.x: The Eye Tribe(www.theeyetribe.com) showcased ‘EYE TRACKER’ at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

EYE TRACKER runs with most newer desktops, laptops and tablets. The high resolution sensor enables to track the tiny movements of the pupils with high precision while maintaining a wide field of view.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
